items.title: How this field hires a master's student
items.detail: Big pharma opens structured summer programs between September and November and often prefers or requires a PhD for biostatistics seats; read the qualification line before the title. Gilead lists PhD as *preferred* on most of its reqs, which is a ranking signal; master's students can still apply. Contract research organizations hire master's statisticians at volume, but later and more rolling, and mostly in SAS. Southern California device companies run their own calendars: Stryker and Edwards' clinical track are open now; Medtronic takes master's applications only until October 13 and interviews in October. Health plans post in a wave at the end of September with offers in November: Blue Shield of California's 2027 interns went up September 30, Centene's on October 6, and both waves were undergraduate, MBA or pharmacy seats. J&J posts batches with two-week windows, so a seat you want can appear and close inside a fortnight.

items.title: Henry Ford Health: Cancer Epidemiology (CEPC) Intern
items.detail:
The program you asked for. Henry Ford's Public Health Sciences department takes the application through its own form, and *Cancer Epidemiology and Prevention and Control (CEPC)* is the first program choice on it. Biostatistics is a listed program of study, and the self-assessment rates R/SAS programming, data analysis, study design and REDCap.

**What the form asks for:** a cover letter on your research background and what you hope to gain, a resume or CV, and transcripts (unofficial is fine). A recommendation letter is optional. You also name two strengths and two things to improve, and rank four priorities; *Statistics and Analysis* is one of them. The role is on-site in Detroit and the form has you acknowledge that.

Your breast cancer recurrence project is the natural lead for the cover letter. Closes October 16 by the date you gave; the form itself shows no date, so do not leave it to the last day. [Apply](https://redcap.hfhs.org/redcap/surveys/?s=AX83M7JKYHH7A8TJ)

items.title: Benchmark: 63.1% of interns converted
items.detail: NACE: *The conversion rate has surged to 63.1% for 2024-25 interns*, from its 2026 Internship & Co-op Survey of 284 organizations. [NACE](https://www.naceweb.org/talent-acquisition/internships/intern-conversion-rate-hits-highest-mark-in-five-years)

items.title: Medtronic: 77% of eligible interns hired
items.detail: Medtronic's newsroom: *77% of eligible interns became full-time employees*, from a program of nearly 400. [Medtronic](https://news.medtronic.com/medtronic-summer-internship-program)

items.title: Stated in tonight's postings
items.detail: Analysis Group: evaluated *for a full-time analyst offer in the office that their internship takes place* (re-read tonight). BRG: *we aim to convert Summer Associates to full-time Associates*. Edwards: *Conversion Opportunities into our New Grad Programs*. J&J Clinical Pharmacology: used to assess *potential for future* hiring. Kite: *Consideration for future full-time positions, rotation programs, or contract roles*. No published rate for any of them.

items.detail: Third-party guide estimates, not company figures, and not re-sourced tonight. Treat as rough.

items.title: How to get the offer
items.detail: Say in week one that you want a return offer and ask what earns one; ship something that outlives the summer; meet people on adjacent teams.

items.title: Read in the browser tonight
items.detail: Both Analysis Group postings (open; Health Care deadline October 28 confirmed on the page), Pfizer's Statistics program intro (January 31) and positions list (still empty), Medtronic's early-careers timeline (master's window closes October 13), and the Michigan Public Health career-fairs page. City of Hope's board is back from maintenance and was read by the sweep: no internship. Blue Shield's Oracle board was found and read tonight.

items.detail: Xencor and Children's Hospital Los Angeles are read weekly (last October 4, next October 11). Puma (*403 Forbidden* on October 2), Arcutis (portal error) and Capsida (LinkedIn only) are not retried nightly. Jazz's Workday site did not answer again. sections.title: What this page ranks against
sections.note: If any of this is wrong, say so and the ranking changes.

items.title: Private industry first: pharma, CROs, biotech
items.detail: Hospital systems and research institutes are fine; no government or public sector. Public universities and their hospitals are excluded; private nonprofits like Kaiser, Cedars-Sinai, City of Hope and Mayo are in.

items.title: Clinical trials, devices, health analytics
items.detail: Genomics stays on the map but ranks last.

items.title: Consulting: scientific yes, strategy no
items.detail: HEOR, epidemiology and economic consulting count (Analysis Group, Exponent). Strategy and management consulting does not (Guidehouse; ZS is out on that rule).

items.title: MS Biostatistics, Michigan, May 2028
items.detail: Master's only. BS Data Science and Anthropology, ASU, 4.0, Barrett Honors.

items.title: R and Python strong, SQL moderate, SAS in progress
items.detail: Also Tableau, R Shiny, ggplot2, scikit-learn; XGBoost recurrence model (AUC 0.75), SARIMA influenza capstone. Open question: **when does the SAS class end?** Reqs that say *SAS and/or R* are open to you now.

items.title: LA, Orange County, Bay Area, San Diego, Phoenix, remote
items.detail: Detroit for Henry Ford Health. One Detroit health-plan seat (BCBS Michigan) is listed last in Open now; say so if Michigan should stay off the page. Actuarial is on your title list; the first actuarial seats this cycle (Blue Shield, Centene) wanted a passed exam or an undergraduate, so say if you plan to sit an exam.
